pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous topological web of light cream-colored pathways. Junction nodes typically connect three to four patches. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the central flank, estimated at 1/10th the average width of adjacent patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and shoulder displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette, though softened by the image resolution.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: No structural breaks or abrupt discontinuities are visible in the captured segment of the dorsal line.
